Yesterday I was out driving my mom to the dentist and stopped at value village to look at media and I found the best collection of cds that I’ve seen in years. Then when i I was checking out the employee said “did you have the media coupon?”
 I said no and she called another employee to apply a discount that was 30% of all media and books. So I saved over $45 on this haul of 90s and early 2000s rock and rap music. It’s almost exactly like the stuff I used to have or want but never had.
 I could have easily picked another 30 cds of similar artists but this was already more than I needed. I have no room for the discs I already have.
    submitted by    /u/pm_social_cues    to    r/Cd_collectors
